events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album, Definitely Maybe, on August 29, 1994, becoming the fastest-selling debut album in British history at the time.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Impact
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music. What's your favourite track from the album that launched a thousand singalongs?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 years on
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York, drawing hundreds of thousands.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million people descended on a dairy farm for three days of peace, love, and music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on!

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only King, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll generations.

events.title: Tupac Shakur shot in Las Vegas
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in a drive-by on September 7, 1996, in Las Vegas, succumbing to his injuries six days later.

angles.name: Tupac Remembrance
angles.copy: Twenty-nine years ago, the music world was rocked by the shooting of Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas. His impact on hip-hop remains undeniable.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27, leaving an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who redefined what a guitar could do. Still inspiring generations, 56 years on.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, Abbey Road, in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic zebra crossing, those timeless tracks... what's your favourite from their final recorded album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the enduring frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the rock icon Chrissie Hynde! Still delivering those powerful vocals and sharp lyrics with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track from the Manchester legend?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's critically acclaimed solo album, Imagine, was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released the iconic 'Imagine' album. Its message of peace and hope resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, Apple launched the original iPod, changing how we listened to music forever. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day Angle
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating 007's cinematic debut. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's his best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon, a co-founder of The Beatles and a prolific solo artist, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and enduring legacy of John Lennon. Imagine all the music...

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius John Cleese! From silly walks to Fawlty Towers, his wit is truly timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. So many incredible tracks, but which one is your favourite?
